_note: v2.3 replan V15c / L5 (the rollback half, live, no model). A real boundary (a /sendas reply, type command) fires start -> road on an extracted delta, and road disables Luke in the test group through the effect ledger. Editing the player message that carried the evidence rolls the story back past the transition, and the rollback's reapply must restore the cast from the ledger: Luke enabled on the REAL group, the story on start. The plan-06 record left this jest-only because `/cp activate` made the rollback point ambiguous; here the transition is fired by a delta at a boundary tied to a message, so the rollback point is exact. The delta is a debug response on purpose: this proves the host restore, which no prompt can. The server copy of the group is read IMMEDIATELY the moment the ledger marks the restore done (polled every 10 ms), before waiting for the rollback notice: ST saves groups through a 1 s debounce, and a restore that answered ok before its save landed is the V15c defect this check found on its second run. From outside the page the debounce is invisible (the edit event is awaited, so the rollback and its persist finish long before a later read), so the check records the ORDER of the requests after the edit: the restore's /api/groups/edit (and its read-back) must land before the rollback's /api/chats/group/save.

const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const id = globalThis.__v15c.evidenceId; const message = ctx.chat[id]; const text = 'We stay by the fire and order another round.'; message.mes = text; if (Array.isArray(message.swipes) && Number.isInteger(message.swipe_id)) message.swipes[message.swipe_id] = text; await ctx.updateMessageBlock?.(id, message); await ctx.saveChat?.(); const log = []; globalThis.__v15c.requests = log; const original = window.fetch; globalThis.__v15c.restoreFetch = () => { window.fetch = original; }; window.fetch = async (input, init) => { const url = String(typeof input === 'string' ? input : input?.url ?? ''); const watched = ['/api/groups/edit', '/api/groups/all', '/api/chats/group/save'].find((path) => url.includes(path)); const response = await original(input, init); if (watched) log.push(watched); return response; }; try { await ctx.eventSource.emit(ctx.eventTypes.MESSAGE_EDITED, id); } finally { setTimeout(() => globalThis.__v15c.restoreFetch(), 5000); } return { edited: id };

[]).includes(globalThis.__v15c.luke)) throw new Error(`the page restored Luke but the server copy of the group still has him disabled: ${JSON.stringify(saved.disabled_members)}`); const order = [...(globalThis.__v15c.requests ?? [])]; const firstEdit = order.indexOf('/api/groups/edit'); const firstPersist = order.indexOf('/api/chats/group/save'); if (firstEdit < 0 || (firstPersist >= 0 && firstEdit > firstPersist)) throw new Error(`the cast restore's group save did not land before the rollback persisted (ST's 1 s debounce was left to write it): ${JSON.stringify(order)}`); const rows = rt.getSnapshot().effects.ledger.filter((entry) => entry.effect === 'cast'); const stillApplied = rows.filter((entry) => entry.status === 'applied'); if (stillApplied.length) throw new Error(`cast rows are still applied after the rollback: ${JSON.stringify(stillApplied)}`); return { order, checkpoint: rt.getEngineState().activeCheckpointId, disabled: group.disabled_members, server: saved?.disabled_members ?? null, rows: rows.map((entry) => entry.status), notice: Boolean(notice) };
